content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record ends with 'The Agency determined that Complainant failed to prove that the Agency subjected her to discrimination or retaliation' but gives no findings or reasoning from the cited ROI evidence to that conclusion, and the Supervisor's responses (ROI 146-162) are cited without content."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Complainant's assertions are tied to ROI page cites (e.g., ROI at 62, 73-74) and the Associate Chief, Chief, and HR Specialist statements are attributed, but the Supervisor's responses to all nine claims are referenced without any summary of what was said."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Claim dates (January 23 to February 20, 2019), the March 13, 2019 complaint filing, and the May 8, 2019 acceptance are dated in order, but the dates of the investigation, ROI delivery, hearing election, and FAD are missing, and the March 18, 2019 'last week of employment' sits unreconciled with a stated resignation effective February 8, 2019."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who issued the FAD, what standard or criteria were applied beyond a citation to 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b), or whether the Supervisor's responses and the uncontacted witnesses' absence were considered before finalization."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because the conclusion is not connected to the evidence and the decision-maker, criteria, and final-stage chronology are absent, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record alone whether the FAD finding is supported."}},"remediation_note":"The record would need the FAD itself, with its findings and reasoning, the decision-maker's identity, the standard applied, and a summary of the Supervisor's responses and how they were weighed. It would also need dates for the investigation, ROI issuance, and FAD, an explanation of why the six listed witnesses were not contacted, and a reconciliation of the resignation and accommodation-withdrawal dates."}
